mechanism_narrative: Sustained decline in TRANSIT mobility (-47.0 to -41.4 over recent weeks) signals persistent commuting suppression. This reduces weekday foot traffic to retail precincts, driving RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks as workers remain remote.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT declined from -39.7 to -47.0 to -41.4 over three weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases by more than 5 percentage points over the next 28 days despite TRANSIT remaining below -35 for all four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Volatile PARKS mobility (ranging -29.3 to +6.0 to -32.1) reflects uncertainty in outdoor recreation preferences. When PARKS falls sharply week-on-week, consumers redirect discretionary spending to indoor retail venues, increasing RETAIL_REC within one week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS declines more than 20 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose to +6.0 in t-1w then fell to -32.1 in t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within one week following a week-on-week PARKS decline exceeding 20 points in at least 3 of 4 test weeks.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility collapsed from -14.3 to -39.9 in t-1w, signaling sudden workplace closures or lockdown tightening. This shock suppresses retail demand as consumers reduce discretionary trips. RETAIL_REC will remain depressed over the next four weeks unless WORKPLACES recovers.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls more than 20 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES dropped 26.2 points from t-2w to t-1w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases above -10 over the next 28 days while WORKPLACES remains below -30 for three or more consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM volatility (-4.9 to +2.4 to -10.1 to -3.6) indicates shifting restrictions on essential retail access. When GROCERY_PHARM is suppressed, policy constraints are tightening; RETAIL_REC will decline proportionally as non-essential retail faces similar restrictions within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls below -5 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM was -10.1 in t-1w and -3.6 in t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases by more than 3 percentage points over the next 14 days when GROCERY_PHARM is below -5 in both weeks.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility remains elevated (3.6 to 7.6 to 6.3) indicating sustained home-based activity. When RESIDENTIAL is high and TRANSIT is low, consumers substitute online shopping for in-store retail. RETAIL_REC will decline over four weeks as this substitution persists.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL above 5 AND TRANSIT below -40 simultaneously
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL was 7.6 and TRANSIT was -47.0 in t-1w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases above -10 over the next 28 days when RESIDENTIAL exceeds 5 and TRANSIT is below -40 for two or more weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-April in Melbourne marks autumn transition with declining outdoor activity (PARKS -32.1). Consumers shift to indoor retail entertainment and shopping. RETAIL_REC will increase over the next four weeks as seasonal preference for indoor venues strengthens.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase above the 28-day baseline mean when PARKS is below -25 at the decision point and remains below -20 for the first two weeks of the forecast period.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC averaged -15.9 over the last four weeks. This persistent depression reflects cumulative demand destruction. Without a shock to WORKPLACES or TRANSIT recovery, inertia will maintain RETAIL_REC below baseline over the next four weeks through habit formation and reduced consumer confidence.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC mean over t-3w to t-0w is -15.9
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases above -5 over the next 28 days without WORKPLACES rising above -15 or TRANSIT rising above -30 for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM and RETAIL_REC move together when policy constraints are uniform across retail sectors. When GROCERY_PHARM recovers from -10.1 to -3.6, it signals easing restrictions. RETAIL_REC will follow with a two-week lag as consumer confidence rebuilds and non-essential retail access expands.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM improves by more than 5 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved 6.5 points from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within two weeks following a week-on-week GROCERY_PHARM improvement exceeding 5 points in at least 2 of 4 test windows.
